from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
import requests,json,re,hashlib
root=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_full_quantity_anchor_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
protocol=readj(root/'protocol.json')
url='https://gxt.ln.gov.cn/gxt/zhzx/xyxx/36B7C88D3C4343BEB6AC49B1D59E13C3/index.shtml'
assert url in readj(root/'实际唯一官方查询原结果.json')['raw_result']

sp.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)

rp.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')

    response=requests.get(url,timeout=(12,35),allow_redirects=True)

    soup=BeautifulSoup(response.text,'html.parser')
    for x in soup.find_all(['script','style']):x.decompose()
    text=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True)
    (root/'sources/2019M07_辽宁政府转载全国完整报告_全文.txt').write_text(text,encoding='utf-8')
    tables=[[[c.get_text('',strip=True) for c in row.find_all(['th','td'],recursive=False)] for row in table.find_all('tr')] for table in soup.find_all('table')]
    metas=[dict(x.attrs) for x in soup.find_all('meta')]
    heads=[x.get_text(' ',strip=True) for x in soup.find_all(['h1','h2'])]
    compact=re.sub(r'\s+','',text)
    pub_contexts=[compact[max(0,m.start()-50):m.end()+100] for m in re.finditer(r'2019[/-]09[/-]03|发文时间|发布时间|国家统计局网站',compact)]
    checks={x:x in compact for x in ['2019年1—7月份全国规模以上工业企业利润下降1.7%','595769.4','502709.6','34977.0','165900','16.59万亿元','应收票据及应收账款平均回收期','2000万元','1月份数据免报','不能直接相比计算增速','应收票据及应收账款平均回收期=']}
    parse={'parsed_at':now(),'source_url':url,'source_sha256':sha(sp),'headings':heads,'metas':metas,'visible_publication_contexts':pub_contexts,'table_count':len(tables),'all_original_table_cell_rows':tables,'required_original_body_and_methods_checks':checks,'all_visible_text':text,'compact_full_text':compact,'stock_labels_read':0,'model_fits':0,'early_NBS_original_first_publication_clock':'UNKNOWN','reprint_clock_only_not_backfilled':True}
    (root/'一真实政府全国报告_全部原表方法与本载体公开钟.json').write_text(json.dumps(parse,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
    receipt.update({'status':'GET_COMPLETED_FULL_RAW_REPORT_SAVED_NOT_YET_ADMITTED','source':sp.as_posix(),'source_sha256':sha(sp),'bytes':len(response.content),'original_table_count':len(tables)})
except Exception as exc:
    receipt.update({'completed_at':now(),'status':'REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY','error_type':type(exc).__name__,'error':str(exc)})
finally:
    rp.write_text(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps(receipt,ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
if receipt['status'].startswith('GET_COMPLETED'):
    print(json.dumps({'headings':heads,'metas':metas,'publication_contexts':pub_contexts,'checks':checks,'tables_first_rows':[t[:5] for t in tables],'methods':compact[-5200:]},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
